digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store bootstrap
propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty orphan branch when configured tickets fetch fails or times out, incorrectly treating network failure as genuine first initialization
_mount_or_create_branch and pending_init_attaches_to_existing must distinguish unreachable remote from legitimately absent branch using a shared tri-state probe result
init must fail closed with actionable error when remote is unreachable or times out, never creating an orphan unless --force-new-store override is explicitly supplied
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount and return without error, allowing strict auto-init path to reuse cached probe result and report the failure
git ls-remote advertisement probe with short timeout must distinguish advertised (exit 0), reachable-absent (exit 2), and unreachable/timeout (exit 124) to enable correct bootstrap decision
bounded fetch remains 300 seconds cold-materialize contract while new advertisement probe uses separate short named timeout, both cached per repo/remote/branch within one CLI invocation TTL
